newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 slips as Komercni Banka continues fall.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 slips as Komercni Banka continues fall.

text.p: Major issues led the PX50 and RPIX indices slightly lower on Thursday as activity fell to just 536 million crowns.
The PX50 lost 1.5 points to 575.1 while the RPIX dropped five crowns to 1,163.
The biggest loser among the highly capitalised shares was Komercni Banka which fell 39 crowns to 2,360 bringing losses in the week so far to 81 points or 3.3 percent.
However, dealers said Komercni's downtrend was unlikely to have been caused by fundamental problems with the company and said technical factors were probably responsible.
"I really do not think fundamentals are behind Komercni's falls. Its more likely to be technical," said Karel Ruzicka of ING Barings.

Ruzicka said the current wave of generally low activity on the Prague Stock Exchange was typical of the region as whole and said a pick-up would depend on the return of foreign investors to the Czech market.
"The index here is really driven by foreign investors and there's not much activity from them now. But it might come," he said.
